project_context: B2B fitness-equipment service platform (Pulse Fitness). Transactional HTML Emails. Must render on Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail, Mobile.

typography.font_stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol'

layouts.grids: NO CSS GRIDS OR FLEXBOX ALLOWED. Use standard <table> with width percentages for columns.

header.description: Customer logo container with brand accent bar.
header.structure: Top border (4px solid {{brand.primary_default}}). White background section. Logo placed inside a padded table cell.

cards.description: Used for feature highlights (Welcome email) or fault summaries.
cards.structure: <table width="100%" style="background: #FAFAFA; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px;">

badges.structure: Inline-block <span> or nested <table>. Padding: 4px 10px. Border-radius: 12px. Font-size: 12px. Font-weight: bold. Border: 1px solid.

data_table.description: Used in Equipment Reassignment. List of machines.
data_table.structure: 100% width table. Header row text-align: left, font-size: 14px, color: #71717A, border-bottom: 2px solid #E4E4E7. Data rows: padding 12px 8px, border-bottom: 1px solid #E4E4E7.

bulletproof_button.description: Outlook-safe CTA. Must use table approach, NOT just padding on anchor.
bulletproof_button.structure: View & Reply

message_quote.structure: Left border: 4px solid #E4E4E7. Padding-left: 16px. Font-style: italic. Color: #52525B. Margin-bottom: 24px.

footer.structure: Background: #F4F5F7. Padding: 24px. Text-align: center. Font-size: 12px. Color: #A1A1AA.
footer.elements: Includes 'Powered by Pulse Fitness' and 'Please do not reply directly to this email.'

media.images: Use absolute URLs. Must include display: block; on all tags to prevent bottom spacing bugs in email clients.

accessibility.tables: All layout tables MUST include role="presentation" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0".
accessibility.images: All images MUST include alt="" attributes. Logos must have the organization name as alt text.
accessibility.contrast: Text colors chosen against background to meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum).

visual_enhancers.borders: Rely heavily on subtle #E4E4E7 borders and specific background color blocks to create hierarchy, since box-shadows do not work reliably in Outlook.

critical_rules: NO EXTERNAL CSS. NO <style> blocks except for media queries.
NO FLEXBOX OR CSS GRIDS. Layout must be exclusively <table> based.
EVERY inline style must be fully qualified (e.g., use padding-top, padding-bottom if shorthand acts up, though standard padding usually works).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for anything containing text; always define solid HEX codes.
Create vanilla HTML templates (as JS template literals or standard HTML files depending on the codebase setup) for the 5 requested emails.
Include a 'Ghost Table' pattern (conditional comments <!--[if mso]>...<![endif]-->) if setting max-width on the main container to ensure Outlook respects the 600px boundary.
Ensure CTA buttons use the bulletproof nested table pattern.
Inject 'data-testid' on dynamic variables and buttons.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Design outputs must feel incredibly premium, intentional, and high-contrast, strictly avoiding the generic AI layout feel.
Avoid centering large blocks of text; left-align data and paragraphs to preserve natural reading flow.
For this email task, prioritize raw table structures, bulletproof email rendering techniques, and high-legibility contrasts.
Use data-testid attribute on all interactive/dynamic tags.
